Location San Francisco preferred US remote by exception US base salary / year $190–235k 0.33–0.88% equity Travel About Once / Quarter As needed for the work Apply for this role ↓ The workWhat you’ll ownWhat we look forWorking hereHow we hireApply The most interesting interface problems in AI are still unsolved. How do you help someone see what could be better, try a direction, and steer toward something worth shipping? You’ll own production interfaces for Impeccable and the tools we build next. That means interaction design, architecture, implementation, testing, performance, and the details people feel even when they can’t name them. Frontend excellence is your specialty: exceptional visual taste, interaction craft, and the judgment to know what makes an interface feel right. You’ve shipped and maintained production software, and you can work across the stack to take an idea through release and the fixes that follow. What you’ll own Take ambiguous product problems from a first prototype to reliable, polished interfaces people use. Build the visual loops for working with AI: critique, compare, iterate, and see what changed. Own frontend architecture, state, API integration, accessibility, testing, and browser performance. Bring care to typography, motion, hierarchy, and interaction. Explain the decisions behind the details. Work across the stack when the best solution calls for it, and stay responsible after the release. What we’re looking for You can walk us through production software you personally built, the engineering tradeoffs, and what happened after launch. You’re fluent in TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and a modern component framework. Your shipped work shows excellent visual and interaction judgment. You can explain why a detail works, and improve it without waiting for a complete design specification. You can diagnose a broken interaction or slow render as confidently as you can improve its design.
